A second, deeper defect found beyond the dispatch's own framing: cli.ts's zipEntryFilter() picks a hardcoded PACS_ENTRY_FILTER regex (APPRAISAL_INFO.TXT / APPRAISAL_IMPROVEMENT_DETAIL.TXT) INSIDE zip.ts, before discoverFiles ever runs. A per-county source declaration wired only into discoverFiles (as the dispatch's item 1 literally describes) would still have the zip extraction step silently discard TCAD's PROP.TXT / IMP_DET.TXT entries before discoverFiles sees them. The fix must be threaded through the entry filter too, county-aware, not format-aware alone.
